zh.title: 斯籍男子持假護照桃機轉機遭攔查 移民署遣返新加坡
zh.summary: 移民署於桃機查獲斯里蘭卡男持假護照轉機；已依國際慣例遣返新加坡。
body: 內政部移民署國境事務大隊表示，執法人員於2026年8月13日在桃園國際機場查獲一名斯里蘭卡籍男子，持用偽造加拿大護照企圖轉機前往加拿大多倫多。該名男子遭移民官當場攔阻登機，並依國際慣例遣返其前一站出發地新加坡。
根據國境事務大隊說明，長榮航空地勤人員在辦理轉機作業時，發現該男子的旅行證件與訂位行程異常並通報。移民官隨後檢視護照防偽特徵並進行詢問，確認證件多處偽造。該男子隨後承認以1萬美元向人蛇集團購買假護照，全案經調查後已完成遣返作業。

en.title: Sri Lankan Transit Passenger Detained at Taoyuan Airport over Fake Passport
en.summary: Taiwan immigration officers intercepted a Sri Lankan passenger carrying a fake passport, deporting him to Singapore.
body: Taiwan's National Immigration Agency Border Affairs Corps announced that officers intercepted a Sri Lankan male passenger at Taoyuan International Airport on August 13, 2026. The passenger was attempting to transit to Toronto, Canada, using a forged Canadian passport. Immigration officials stopped him from boarding and deported him back to Singapore, his previous departure point, in accordance with international practice.

The investigation was initiated after EVA Air ground staff flagged irregularities in the passenger's travel documents and booking itinerary during transit processing. Border officers inspected the passport's security features and questioned the man, who subsequently confessed to purchasing the counterfeit document from a human smuggling syndicate for 10,000 U.S. dollars.
